entities.summary: Albert Thomas Lucas was a professional basketball player who spent four seasons with the Sheboygan Redskins in the National Basketball League and one season in the Basketball Association of America (BAA) as a member of the Boston Celtics during the 1948–49 season. He attended Fordham University.
